title: Console marketplace: the hosted (cloud) install path sends installMode and shows the managed/unmanaged picker; today only the install-local page offers it (cloud#3624)
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-baozhoutao · session_013w7BrxKc6dUYe6Rw6tQW4G

Filing gate: **④ coordination**, a framework half of objectstack-ai/cloud#3624. That card's ruling is A, maintainer 「A + 两边审计 + 转发安装人（推荐）」, record objectstack-ai/cloud#3624 comment 6686728844 (2026-11-06T14:06Z): one install door, with `installMode` as an optional parameter the control plane judges. Carrier split: the console `installPackage()` and the environment `CloudConnectionPlugin` are framework code, each filed as its own objectstack card.

**Business reason.** Starter templates built to be owned (unmanaged) arrive managed on hosted cloud, because the console's cloud install path cannot name the mode.

**Reader who acts.** The lane owning `ui/packages/app-shell` (triage sets lane and grade).

**Dedupe:** `installPackage installMode` → no card.

## Measured (pin `c50e0dfa`, cloud dev reading relayed on objectstack-ai/cloud#3624 comment 6686030999)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts` `installPackage()` sends `package_id` and `seed_sample_data` only.
- The picker (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`) exists only on the install-local path, gated on `features.installLocal`, which hosted sets to `false`.

## Ask

- `installPackage()` takes an optional `installMode` (the spec's `INSTALL_MODES` values) and sends it.
- On the cloud path, show the picker when the package's `installModes` permits more than `managed`, read through the same resolver the install-local page uses.
- Refusals come back as the framework's codes; render them as the install-local page does.

**Acceptance note from the ruling:** an unmanaged copy does not appear in the marketplace "Installed" list, which reads `sys_package_installation`. It appears as the environment's own base, and that is not a bug.
